decisive_spans.text: Dense granulomatous infiltrate in the upper dermis consisting of histiocytes, lymphocytes, foam cells, multinucleated giant cells, eosinophils, and hemorrhage
negative for CD1a and S-100, positive for CD68

response.rationale: Gaucher disease is supported by the presence of foam cells, multinucleated giant cells, and a dense granulomatous infiltrate, along with negative CD1a/S-100 and positive CD68. Niemann-Pick disease also has foam cells and a similar infiltrate, but the specific immunohistochemical markers make Gaucher disease a better fit.
